'''Yit Fun Yap'''<ref name="dt-10302">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10302 Analog Bubblebath], DeckTech (Yit Fun "turboinsan" Yap, 8 September 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/10302/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/10302/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018125130/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/10302/ Wayback Machine].</ref> (DeckTech handle '''turboinsan''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|Set Your Course For Alderaan]] list on DeckTech in September 2000.
